title: Horses Interlude
materials: Household rhythm sticks or wooden spoons
quest_mission: Join Vesta & Silas in Terrasol on an acoustic sensory quest to explore Horses Interlude.
rhythm_ignition: Teacher models a steady 2-minute rhythmic call-and-response beat to 'Horses Interlude', synchronizing clapping and vocal chanting with the children.
tactile_ritual:
The Hands-On Sensory Discovery:
1. Children gather in a circle with tactile items.
2. Follow the musical cues of Horses Interlude to touch, sort, and move in rhythmic unison.
3. Pair high-reach movements with deep somatic exhalations.
4. Freeze in quiet stillness at the final chord.

socratic_wonder_circle.rhythm_cue: Three-Beat Detective Knock ('Wait a Minute — Check the Evidence!')
socratic_wonder_circle.wait_time_rule: Hold a calm 4-beat pause after every question before inviting responses.
prompts: Evaluating Evidence (S-33): In 'Horses Interlude', donkeys, sheep, pigs, and chickens showed up first—what exact sound and body clues proved each one was NOT a horse?
Testing Assumptions (S-30): Why might someone assume a donkey is a horse at first glance, and what closer observations separate the two?
Intellectual Humility (S-5): When we hear an unfamiliar animal sound behind a curtain, why is it wise to say 'Let's listen again and check clues' before deciding?

age_tier_scaffolds.Sprouts (Ages 2–4): Sort animal voice clues aloud: 'Horse sound or different friend?'
age_tier_scaffolds.Pathfinders (Ages 4–5): Name two observable clues (ears, hooves, voice, size) that separate a horse from a donkey or sheep.
age_tier_scaffolds.Wayfarers (Ages 6–7): Explain why one shared trait (four legs) is not enough evidence to classify two creatures as identical.

domain_spider.language: Articulate clear auditory phrasing and target vocabulary connected to Horses Interlude.
domain_spider.cognitive: Identify rhythmic patterns, tempo shifts, and conceptual categories in Terrasol.
domain_spider.physical: Gross motor whole-body balance, bilateral coordination, and fine motor finger rhythm.
domain_spider.science_sensory: Tactile exploration of real-world materials and acoustic auditory pitch discrimination.
domain_spider.social_emotional: Cooperative participation, shared attentional focus, and calming self-regulation.

teacher_whisper: Auditory rhythmic pacing stimulates brainstem regulation and synchronizes attention across the classroom without visual screen fatigue.

standards.kindergarten_readiness: Differentiates domestic animal attributes (equine vs. livestock) using auditory cues and morphological vocabulary.
